messages: Rae: quick UX QA: export CSV header order doesn't match the preview table which is confusing customers. export currently: id,vector,score,meta. table shows: checkbox,id,meta,score. Kobi: agreed, CSV should mirror visible UI order (excluding checkbox). I'll update mapping to [id,meta,score,vector]. Lina: a11y: screen readers read the score pill then an SR helper text, so users hear the number twice. We should keep only SR helper and mark visual pill aria-hidden. Ethan: also seeing odd keyboard nav when dense rows are enabled. arrow keys sometimes skip to inspector close button. suspect virtual list focus/unmount race. Priya: proposal: default to comfortable rows, add opt-in "Dense preview" toggle with tooltip: "Dense preview (opt-in) — show more rows per page; may affect keyboard nav and performance on very large lists." short: "Show more rows (opt-in)". Marta: implementation notes: 1) use SR-only label for relevance e.g., "Relevance: 0.87" and aria-hidden on visual value; 2) add aria-live polite announcer for bulk selection (debounced ~200ms) to say "X items selected"; 3) when inspector opens, move focus into the panel instead of the close X. Rae: sample SR pattern for score: <span class="sr-only">Relevance: 0.92</span> <span aria-hidden="true">0.92</span> Kobi: noted. I'll change CSV mapping, add export tests, and implement aria-hidden on visible score. Ethan: for virtualization: pin focused row (scrollIntoView) before focusing, or shift focus into inspector when it opens. I'll prototype a fix. Lina: small visual nit: dark theme score pill contrast is ~3.6:1; need to reach 4.5:1 for small text. design can suggest alternate colors or an outline treatment. Marta: will add color options to the token page and include the microcopy for the dense toggle + score tooltip. Priya: can we add the dense preference to user settings (persistent opt-in)? users keep toggling it per session. Rae: yes, let's add that as a follow-up. For now, aim to land CSV + SR fixes this sprint and schedule the virtualization/focus work next. Kobi: :thumbsup: opening PR now, will tag the group.
